verse.verse_2: and you are dwelling in this city --
verse.verse_4: that We have created man into a life of toil and trial.
verse.verse_5: Does he think then that no one has power over him?
verse.verse_6: He says, "I have spent enormous wealth."
verse.verse_7: Does he then think that no one sees him?
verse.verse_8: Have We not given him two eyes,
verse.verse_9: and a tongue, and a pair of lips,
verse.verse_10: and shown him the two paths?
verse.verse_11: But he has not attempted the ascent.
verse.verse_12: What will explain to you what the ascent is?
verse.verse_13: It is the freeing of a slave;
verse.verse_14: or the feeding in times of famine
verse.verse_16: or some needy person in distress,
verse.verse_17: and to be one of those who believe and urge one another to steadfastness and compassion.
verse.verse_18: Those who do so are the people of the right hand,
verse.verse_19: and [as for] those who are bent on denying the truth of Our revelations, they are the people of the left hand,
verse.verse_20: and the Fire will close in on them.
